run_validate_constraints: run the fairseq constraint validation script on a generated output file via stdin
run_check_constraints_in_hypothesis: run the script to verify C- constraint lines appear in the first H- hypothesis line
run_validate_fairseq_output: run the validation script to check that all constraints are present in fairseq output
run_count_constraint_satisfaction: run the script to count and report the percentage of constraints satisfied in output
run_report_missing_constraints: run the script to print missing constraints to stderr and a summary to stdout
